title: Menger's theorem, Hamiltonian cycles, long cycles and pancyclicity
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of Menger's theorem for finite graphs (set form with a minimum separator and as many vertex-disjoint paths, two-vertex form, edge form for Mathlib's IsEdgeReachable, and the global edge form for Mathlib's IsEdgeConnected) and of classical sufficient conditions for Hamiltonian cycles: the Bondy–Chvátal closure step, Ore's and Dirac's theorems, and the Chvátal–Erdős theorem (k-connected with independence number at most k implies Hamiltonian), whose proof uses Menger's theorem through the fan lemma. Version 2 adds the Erdős–Gallai theorems on long paths and cycles (no path on k vertices implies 2e ≤ (k − 2)n; no cycle of length at least k ≥ 3 implies 2e ≤ (k − 1)(n − 1)) and Bondy's pancyclicity theorem (a Hamiltonian graph with at least n²/4 edges is pancyclic or is K_{n/2,n/2}), proved on top of the same library.
